cases.task: Choose the safe dashboard rule when an SSE application event repeats the last already accepted event ID but carries a different payload.

required_facts.text: Every application event represents a new durable event-log sequence and therefore must advance strictly beyond the accepted cursor.
Equality remains valid for ready and page boundaries because those frames may confirm an already accepted cursor without adding a new application event.
A repeated or regressive application event ID must close the stream, preserve the accepted cursor, reject the replayed payload, and fence queued callbacks.
